answer: Proposal: auction each unit of work first-price, bids escrowed in a vault contract, burning a fixed fraction of every losing bid. To sweep the whole knoll of tasks a farm must bid with many keys at once; one key wins, the other N-1 forfeit burn, so extra keys add cost, not revenue, and self-bidding makes costs spiral while the gain stays one task fee. An honest agent with one key risks one modest burn; the attacker pays it N-1 times per task. Assumes irrevocable escrow and verifiable work; refunding losers would erase the sybil price, so the burn must stay nonzero.
